# Orbit Student

> Mentor-led AI literacy, entrepreneurship and leadership for ages 8–18. Live cohort classes, student dashboard, portfolio projects and scholarship preparation. Serving families in 35+ countries.

## What Orbit Student is

Orbit Student (orbitstudent.com) is an instructor-led online programme for kids and teens. Students learn AI tools, entrepreneurship, public speaking and leadership through live mentor sessions — not pre-recorded video libraries. Outcomes include shipped projects, pitch practice and a scholarship-ready portfolio.

## Who it is for

- Parents of children ages 8–18 seeking live AI and entrepreneurship classes
- Students who want to build real projects, pitch ideas and prepare for scholarships
- Families comparing PlanetSpark-style public speaking or BrightCHAMPS-style coding programmes who want mentor-led cohorts with portfolio outcomes
